verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud phone platform that stores call recordings, transcripts and messages, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention policy, retention period setting, or delete endpoint. Pausing and resuming recording only controls what gets captured, and importing recordings into your own infrastructure is a user-side workaround, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
